probe.question: Rank the oxidation-prone sites on COc1ccc(-c2ccccc2C(=O)O)cc1 and tell me how easy the whole molecule is to oxidise.
forbids_claims: converting the ranking into a degradation rate, a percentage or a shelf-life
presenting the ranking as a prediction of what will be observed
quoting Fukui indices as if they were measured quantities
probe.direction: Runs the site ranking in electrophilic mode and reports the ordered sites in chemical language, plus the global measure (HOMO / ionisation-related descriptor) for "how easy overall". Sanity-checks the ranking against the classic liabilities for this structure — the methoxy-activated ring. States the ceiling: this says where the molecule is electronically vulnerable, not whether it will degrade or how fast.
